findings.why: The only change is that the clientSecret-required error for the already-configured provider (index 0) disappeared, while the new provider's missing secret and the blank clientId are still rejected, which matches c1.

Re-enabling with an existing provider resubmitted without its secret no longer reports clientSecret as blank (its stored secret is kept, per c1); the request still fails on the blank clientId, so the status is unchanged.
